notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You control at least five lands.
description:
Activate Inkmoth Nexus' first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Inkmoth Nexus' second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature that is still a land until end of turn.
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}, exchanging the text boxes of Inkmoth Nexus and Scute Swarm.
Play a land.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Inkmoth Nexus's Scute Swarm ability, creating a token copy of Inkmoth Nexus with its original text.
Step 5 repeats in a mandatory loop unless interrupted, drawing the game.
